• What we offer you - Annual subscription "update Fitness" - CHF 500 for laptop or tablet - 50% off first mobile plan from Coop Mobile - SBB Half-Fare travelcard or GA travelcard share CHF 650 - Many discounts for Employees Christina Igrek HR Vocational Training Choose Your Character - Create Your Future: Shape your future with a suitable apprenticeship.
